messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Could not find function "exiftoolPath"
parts:
Hi Hasan,
The function has been renamed to 
addToPath()
due to its versatility. 
I often use it for other software I want to use with system() calls or make available to the R session, so the old name was too limiting. 

Fyi, it was mentioned in the package news, so in a situation like this it makes sense to check the news file.

https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/camtrapR/news/news.html

Best regards,
Jürgen 

On Mon, Apr 29, 2024, 10:00 Hasan Rahman <hasanra...@gmail.com> wrote:
Dear Juergen, 

I used CamtrapR last year and haven't touched it ever since, but I just tried to run it for this year data and encountering issue with the function exiftoolPath, whenever I am running the following code to locate the exiftool 
exiftoolPath("E:/Cameratrap/win_exe") #Make sure you have the right folder here, copy from folder directory
Sys.which("exiftool.exe")

I am seeing error message, 
Error in exiftoolPath("E:/Cameratrap/win_exe") : could not find function "exiftoolPath" > Sys.which("exiftool.exe") exiftool.exe ""
Could you please help me with this?
Thank you so much,
Hasan
